projects.title: Sheetr, a spritesheet packer
projects.desc: Sheetr is a small web app, aimed at creating sprite sheets from single images. You simply drag and drop them into Sheetr, and Sheetr will automatically create a sheet, as well as a .json file with informations about each group of frames. You could for example have 2 folders with individual frames for 2 animations, and sheetr will combine everything into one sheet, and return, where to look the frames for each animation up.
